__doc__: Opt-in moving-obstacle fragment to MERGE into a mission runtime-config (e.g. mission-runtime-cc.json) for the dynamic-obstacle evidence run. Adds three things, all default-off when absent: (1) navigation.dynamic_obstacles builds the in-process DynamicObstacleLayer on the sensor route; (2) navigation.dynamic_obstacle_source names the lane-owned detection-feed builder; (3) the humans block authors one deterministic scripted person crossing the outbound aisle, reused as both the rendered actor and the detection source. navigation.blocked_timeout is the stop-and-wait patience on a blocked aisle. Tune the person waypoints to cross the actual outbound leg of your scenario. See docs/restock_navigation.md 'Mission detection feed'.
